Here, we explore and extend this idea to the domain of human episodic memory encoding and retrieval. Incorporating findings from the synaptic to cognitive levels of organization, we argue that spectrally precise cross-frequency coupling and phase-synchronization promote the formation of hippocampal-neocortical cell assemblies that form the basis for episodic memory. We suggest that both cell assembly firing patterns as well as the global pattern of brain oscillatory activity within hippocampal-neocortical networks represents the contents of a particular memory. Drawing upon the ideas of context reinstatement and multiple trace theory, we argue that memory retrieval is driven by internal and/or external factors which recreate these frequency-specific oscillatory patterns which occur during episodic encoding. These ideas are synthesized into a novel model of episodic memory (the spectro-contextual encoding and retrieval theory, or \"SCERT\") that provides several testable predictions for future research.","affiliation":"Center for Neuroscience, University of California Davis, CA, USA ; University of Bonn, Bonn Germany.","publicationStatus":"epublish","language":"eng","pubModel":"Electronic-eCollection","pubTypeList":{"pubType":["research-article","Journal Article"]},"grantsList":{"grant":[{"agency":"NINDS NIH HHS","acronym":"NS","grantId":"R01 NS076856","orderIn":0}]},"keywordList":{"keyword":["Hippocampus","Oscillations","Neocortex","Episodic memory","Cross-frequency Coupling","Cell Assembly","Phase-synchronization","Context Reinstatement"]},"fullTextUrlList":{"fullTextUrl":[{"availability":"Open access","availabilityCode":"OA","documentStyle":"html","site":"Unpaywall","url":"https://escholarship.org/uc/item/2nc3j77h"},{"availability":"Subscription required","availabilityCode":"S","documentStyle":"doi","site":"DOI","url":"https://doi.org/10.3389/fnhum.2014.00075"},{"availability":"Open access","availabilityCode":"OA","documentStyle":"html","site":"Europe_PMC","url":"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC3927099"},{"availability":"Open access","availabilityCode":"OA","documentStyle":"pdf","site":"Europe_PMC","url":"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC3927099?pdf=render"}]},"isOpenAccess":"Y","inEPMC":"Y","inPMC":"Y","citedByCount":44,"hasReferences":"Y","hasTextMinedTerms":"Y","hasDbCrossReferences":"N","hasPDF":"Y","hasBook":"N","hasSuppl":"N","hasLabsLinks":"Y","hasData":"N","license":"cc by","authMan":"N","epmcAuthMan":"N","nihAuthMan":"N","hasTMAccessionNumbers":"N","dateOfCompletion":"2014-03-06","dateOfCreation":"2014-03-07","dateOfRevision":"2021-10-21","electronicPublicationDate":"2014-02-18","firstPublicationDate":"2014-02-18","firstIndexDate":"2014-03-07","fullTextReceivedDate":"2025-02-05","hasEvaluations":"N"}]}}
